title: Pop-up Panic: Windows 95 Edition
description: Click the X to close endless pop-up ads on a Windows 95 desktop before they cover the entire screen and trigger the Blue Screen of Death!
prompt: make a game that fills the screens with buttons and randomly generated adds like its early 2000's internet. you have to click the x to close them as fast as its generating. once the whole screen is covered you loose. make it windows 95 themed with a start menu and it looks like a computer from that era. when the screen fills you get a blue crash screen and you loose.
